title: Voltage-sensor conformational microenvironments encode isoform-selective ion channel activation.
authors: Manville, Rian W; Foglia, Lorenzo; Yoshimura, Ryan F; Santos, Daniel E; Yu, Alvin; Abbott, Geoffrey W
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America
one_liner_zh: 该文结合MD模拟与电生理实验，揭示Kv7.3电压传感器构象微环境决定香紫苏酸异构体选择性激活机制，虽以离子通道为对象，但其构象采样与结合机制计算方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算研究。
abstract: Isoform-selective opening of voltage-gated potassium (Kv) channels is desirable for its therapeutic potential yet mechanistically little-understood. Rosemary leaf metabolite carnosic acid (CA) is a high-efficacy opener of the neuronal Kv7.3 channel but exerts minimal effects on Kv7.2 or Kv7.2/3 heteromers. Here, using alanine-scanning mutagenesis, electrophysiology, radioligand binding, and all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, we found that CA achieves high-efficacy activation of Kv7.3 by binding at the extracellular cap of the voltage-sensing domain (VSD), independent of the canonical retigabine pore binding site. Kv7.3 samples a binding-competent VSD conformation absent in Kv7.2, characterized by an expanded extracellular pocket and a favorable electrostatic environment. Central to this mechanism, Kv7.3-L226 functions as a hydrophobic latch that tunes the energetic landscape of the voltage sensor to control ligand efficacy. Unexpectedly, CA potentiates Kv7.2/3 activation by retigabine via ligand-initiated positive allosteric coupling between the VSD and pore, thus enhancing the anticonvulsant action of retigabine despite CA lacking standalone anticonvulsant activity. The findings establish a mechanistic framework in which isoform selectivity arises from VSD conformational microenvironments rather than canonical binding determinants and highlight the voltage sensor as a tunable target for developing selective Kv channel openers.
abstract_zh: 电压门控钾（Kv）通道的亚型选择性开放因其治疗潜力而备受期待，但其机制尚不明确。迷迭香叶代谢物鼠尾草酸（carnosic acid, CA）是神经元Kv7.3通道的高效能开放剂，但对Kv7.2或Kv7.2/3异源多聚体影响甚微。在此，我们利用丙氨酸扫描诱变、电生理学、放射性配体结合及全原子分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟发现，CA通过结合电压传感域（voltage-sensing domain, VSD）的胞外帽区实现Kv7.3的高效能激活，且不依赖于经典的瑞替加滨孔域结合位点。Kv7.3采样一种在Kv7.2中缺失的结合胜任型VSD构象，其特征为扩大的胞外口袋和有利的静电环境。该机制的核心在于，Kv7.3-L226作为疏水闩锁，调节电压传感器的能量景观以控制配体效能。出乎意料的是，CA通过配体引发的VSD与孔域之间的正变构偶联增强瑞替加滨对Kv7.2/3的激活，从而增强瑞替加滨的抗惊厥作用，尽管CA本身缺乏独立的抗惊厥活性。这些发现建立了一个机制框架，其中亚型选择性源于VSD构象微环境而非经典结合决定因素，并强调电压传感器作为开发选择性Kv通道开放剂的可调靶点。
